package render

import (
	"fmt"
	"strings"

	"testpkg/posts"
	"testpkg/related"
)

func Page(slug string) (string, bool) {
	post, ok := posts.Find(slug)
	if !ok || post.Draft {
		return "", false
	}
	var page strings.Builder
	fmt.Fprintf(&page, "<h1>%s</h1><p>%s</p><p>%d min, %s</p><ul>", post.Title, post.Description, post.Minutes, post.Year)
	for _, other := range related.Related(slug, 3) {
		fmt.Fprintf(&page, "<li><a href=%q>%s</a></li>", other.URL, other.Title)
	}
	page.WriteString("</ul>")
	return page.String(), true
}
